tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand warm bright cream paper. Main backgrounds and large negative space; text on `ink` and `lilac` grounds in dark layouts.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Warm editorial card surface on top of `paper` or `paper-shade`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. All type on `paper`, `card`, `lime`, `lilac` and `orange`; outlines, technical graphics and dark backgrounds.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Technical accent. Indicators, highlights, labels and the project-number block. Text on it is always `ink`.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Secondary field. Concept and experimental slides, comparison columns. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-soft`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Artificial-life accent. Xuân / Xuna, character frames, warm highlights. Text on it is `ink`; never use it for body text on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: Warm sand panel tint. Secondary panels, relief blocks next to `paper`. Not for text.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper`, `card`, `paper-shade`, `lime` and `lilac`. Not on `orange`: use `ink` there.

tokens.name: paper-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ink` (7.6:1). Captions and metadata in dark layouts.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: Technical grid overlay lines on `paper` / `ink`. Decorative only: never carries text or meaning.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and slide ground in the current theme.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text, outlines and rules on `surface` (13.4:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and mono metadata on `surface` (7.7:1 light, 7.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Header, footer and section rules, frame borders and annotation lines on `surface` (3:1 minimum).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Single-word project titles on covers (XUNA). One per post.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Section headings, step titles, quiet CTAs.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs on covers. Minimum body size 28.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, left-aligned, 36 characters or more per line.
styles.sample: XUNA lives on a pixel display.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and step descriptions in `muted`. Minimum 24.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Upper-case labels, tags, IDs, header and footer text.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, coordinates, annotations. Never for sentences.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values in technical labels and data readouts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base unit. Gaps inside tags, status indicators and icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value, small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Column gutter and gap between steps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside panels and frames; gap between text blocks.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Outer margin of every post format and the technical grid module.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large separation between sections on a slide.

tokens.name: margin-post
tokens.usage: Left, right, top and bottom margin on 4:5, 1:1 and the sides of 9:16.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter on the 6-column (4:5, 1:1) and 4-column (9:16) grids.

tokens.name: safe-top-vertical
tokens.usage: 9:16: keep text and key visuals below this line (platform top UI).

tokens.name: safe-bottom-vertical
tokens.usage: 9:16: keep text and key visuals above this distance from the bottom (captions, buttons).

tokens.name: safe-right-vertical
tokens.usage: 9:16: keep text clear of the right-hand action rail.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Frames, panels, blocks, labels, expid, images: everything is square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Category tags only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Pins, step numbers, status discs, targeting rings.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Grid lines, dividers between table rows, secondary rings.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Default outline: rules, frames, tags, annotation lines, crosshairs.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Pixel-art character frame and format outlines.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Paper grain overlay strength on light slides (multiply). None on dark slides beyond 0.06 screen.

tokens.name: halftone-opacity
tokens.usage: Halftone fade strength on image frames and panels.

tokens.name: halftone-pitch
tokens.usage: Halftone dot spacing.

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Dot-grid spacing for diagram and Pixel Life backgrounds.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Technical grid overlay module, equal to the outer margin.
